## Kind of change

- [ ] Stack reference update (say which SDK or library version you verified against)

## Checklist

- [ ] `node scripts/validate.mjs` passes locally
- [ ] No new scripts, binaries or workflows outside `examples/` and `scripts/`
- [ ] No HTML comments or hidden text in `SKILL.md`, `references/` or `templates/`
- [ ] Existing tell and rule IDs are unchanged
- [ ] Every new reference file is listed in `SKILL.md` under References
